title: Targeted Advertising Platforms: Pooling Audiences Despite Poaching Risk
abstract: arXiv:2510.27112v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: E-commerce platforms are inviting merchants to contribute their own audiences to a common pool that the platform uses to identify and target customers most likely to click on merchants' ads. While pooling audiences allows a merchant to reach new customers, it also creates a poaching risk. We develop a model of targeted advertising, in which each customer has merchant-specific click-through rates, and study how a platform can incentivize merchants to pool audiences despite poaching risk. We characterize the mechanism that maximizes a weighted sum of platform revenue, merchants' surplus, and customer engagement, measured by expected clicks. translated_title: 定向广告平台：尽管存在挖角风险仍汇集受众
translated_abstract: 电子商务平台正在邀请商家将自己的受众贡献到一个公共池中，平台利用该池来识别并定向触达最有可能点击商家广告的客户。虽然汇集受众能让商家触达新客户，但也会带来“挖角”风险。我们建立了一个定向广告模型，其中每个客户都具有商家专属的点击率，并研究平台如何在存在挖角风险的情况下激励商家汇集受众。我们刻画了能够最大化平台收入、商家剩余以及以预期点击量衡量的客户参与度这三者加权总和的机制。在规模足够大的平台上，当商家按可观测标签 k ∈ K 分组时，最优机制为每个标签 k 的商家提供三种选择：(i) 免费获得基于汇集受众构建、能带来其基线预期点击量的广告活动；(ii) 通过付费来扩展该活动（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文针对电商平台的受众共享问题建立了定向广告模型，刻画了在挖角风险下能够激励商家汇集自有受众的最优机制——为每类商家提供免费基线广告活动、付费扩展等多种选项，以最大化平台收入、商家剩余与客户点击参与度的加权和。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a targeted advertising model and characterizes the optimal mechanism that incentivizes merchants to pool their audiences despite poaching risk—offering merchants grouped by tags a menu of options including a free baseline campaign and paid expansion—to maximize a weighted sum of platform revenue, merchant surplus, and customer engagement.
